newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Police seek fugitive after Auckland gun incident.
newsitem.headline: Police seek fugitive after Auckland gun incident.

text.p: Auckland police were seeking an escaped gunman on Tuesday after an incident in which he fired at a 16-year-old schoolgirl, Radio New Zealand said.

The man entered the Northcote College swimming pool changing sheds on Monday and told the girl and a friend: "You're for it now." A shot was fired, but onlookers managed to seize the gun, the radio said.
Police, who were unsuccessful in finding the man overnight, described him as disturbed and dangerous.
